description: This file defines the FilesAPI interface in Kotlin, which provides Retrofit HTTP methods for interacting with a remote service related to direct editing information and URLs, as part of the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

classes.name: FilesAPI
classes.description: Retrofit API interface for file-related operations pertaining to direct editing, including fetching editing info and URLs.

methods.name: getDirectEditingInfo
methods.description: Performs a GET request to retrieve direct editing information from the server in JSON format.

methods.name: getDirectEditingUrl
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a request body to obtain a URL for direct editing in JSON format.
